title: Title length
statementMd:
Show the five books with the longest titles (by characters). Break ties by title.

Expected columns: `title`, `chars`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, LENGTH(title) AS chars FROM books ORDER BY chars DESC, title LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
